stories.title: MY STORY MY MOTIVATIONS
stories.content:
📱 NO LAPTOP. NO TUITION. NO EXCUSES.
After completing my KCSE exams, I hit a massive wall. Financial blockades meant I couldn't afford traditional higher education. I was forced to sit at home.

The world told me to wait. But I looked at the 6-inch smartphone in my hand and said: NO.

I refused to let my current environment dictate my ultimate destination. I realized that a smartphone is either a distraction engine or a production powerhouse. The difference is pure execution.

I chose Online Education and built my engineering path brick by brick, platform by platform. I didn't skip any steps. I climbed the ladder of execution from the ground up:

HP Life & Simplilearn: The foundation
UniAthena & Alison Academy: Professional infrastructure
Cisco Networking Academy: Core routing & networks
Saylor Academy & The Open University: Rigorous computer science frameworks
WorldQuant University, Kaggle & IBM: Data streams & quantitative analysis
Harvard University Open Courseware: Global tier logic
FreeCodeCamp: Hours of raw, interactive compilation

Today, I am a Computer Science major at the University of the People, downloading modules over public Wi-Fi at Nyayo Gardens and the Kenya National Library in Nakuru!
They call me THE SMARTPHONE SCIENTIST.

My development sandbox isn't an expensive multi-monitor desk setup. My sandbox is a mobile phone. My terminal is Termux. My text editor is Micro. My compiler is Pydroid 3.

Every single night, I open the Eisenhower Decision Matrix to map out my tomorrow. Every single morning, I "Eat the Frog" by tackling my hardest data structure or backend logic task first thing.

When my phone screen feels too small or a script fails, I don't quit. I lean into The Power of Yet. I don't say "I can't code this." I say "I haven't figured it out yet."

I am currently working and budgeting to secure a dedicated Windows 11 laptop by January 2027 to scale my technical ecosystem—but I am not waiting for perfect conditions to build my empire. I am executing right now.

To anyone out there sitting on their dreams because they lack resources: Stop using your limitations as an alibi for your inertia.
If a 20-year-old student from Nakuru can run full-stack apps and study computer science from a smartphone, you have zero excuses left.

Stop looking at what is missing.
Look at what is already in your hands.
Work with what you have, where you are, right now.
IT'S ALL POSSIBLE. 🚀

#TheSmartphoneScientist #ComputerScience #GrowthMindset #TechInAfrica #UoPeople #ContinuousLearning #EduTech #NoExcuses

stories.title: Some of my projects and achievements
stories.content:
I started with one step. No skipping.

People might think that you just become a great computer scientist (Software Engineer and AI specialist) in just a day.

It takes time, efforts, investment and Discipline to achieve this.

You need to go step by step. Beginner to pro.

stories.title: Award for being the best student and THE SMARTPHONE SCIENTIST
stories.content:
While other students were sleeping, I was awake, Building my empire, advancing my brain and expanding my territories.

Never give up, never compare yourself with others. Just be you, the real you.
